title: Sustainable production of ZnO nanoparticles via capparis decidua stem extract for efficient photocatalytic Rh 6G dye degradation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,46890-46907
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05878C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Asmaa M. Sayed, Fawzy M. Salama, Hanaa K. Galal, Mohamed I. Said
Zinc oxide nanoparticles (ZnO NPs) were sustainably synthesized using Capparis decidua stem extract as a green capping and stabilizing agent, and their photocatalytic efficiency toward Rhodamine 6G (Rh 6G) degradation was evaluated.
